verses.ar: طَالَمَا أَشْكُو غَرَامِي يَا نُورَ الْوُجُودْ (2) ۞ وَأُنَادِي يَا تِهَامِي يَا مَعْدِنَ الْجُودْ (2)
verses.tr: Ṭālamā ashkū gharāmī yā nūra l-wujūd (2). Wa-unādī yā tihāmī yā maʿdina l-jūd (2).
verses.en: How long have I lamented my yearning for you, O Light of Existence (2)! And I call out, "O Tihami [Prophet Muhammad ﷺ], O Source of Generosity (2)!"

verses.ar: مُنْيَتِي أَقْصَى مَرَامِي أَحْظَى بِالشُّهُودْ (2) ۞ وَأَرَى بَابَ السَّلَامِ يَا زَاكِي الْجُدُودْ (2)
verses.tr: Munyatī aqṣā marāmī aḥẓā bi-sh-shuhūd (2). Wa-arā bāba s-salāmi yā zāki l-judūd (2).
verses.en: My wish and highest aspiration is to be blessed with your vision (2). And to behold the Gate of Peace [Paradise], O Pure One of noble lineage (2).

verses.ar: يَا طِرَازَ الْكَوْنِ إِنِّي عَاشِقٌ مُسْتَهَامْ (2) ۞ مُغْرَمٌ وَالْمَدْحُ فَنِّي يَا بَدْرَ التَّمَامْ (2)
verses.tr: Yā ṭirāza l-kawni innī ʿāshiqun mustahām (2). Mughramun wa-l-madḥu fannī yā badra t-tamām (2).
verses.en: O Adornment of the Universe, I am an ardent lover (2), Consumed by love, and praise is my art, O Perfect Full Moon (2)!

verses.ar: اِصْرِفِ الْأَعْرَاضَ عَنِّي أَضْنَانِي الْغَرَامْ (2) ۞ فِيكَ قَدْ حَسَّنْتُ ظَنِّي يَا سَامِي الْعُهُودْ (2)
verses.tr: Iṣrifi l-aʿrāḍa ʿannī aḍnāni l-gharām (2). Fīka qad ḥassantu ẓannī yā sāmi l-ʿuhūd (2).
verses.en: Turn afflictions away from me, longing has worn me down (2). In you I have placed my finest hopes, O Upholder of noble covenants (2).

verses.ar: يَا سِرَاجَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ يَا عَالِي الْجَنَابْ (2) ۞ يَا إِمَامَ الْأَتْقِيَاءِ إِنَّ قَلْبِي ذَابْ (2)
verses.tr: Yā sirāja l-anbiyā'i yā ʿāli l-janāb (2). Yā imāma l-atqiyā'i inna qalbī dhāb (2).
verses.en: O Lantern of the Prophets, O Exalted One (2)! O Leader of the God-fearing, my heart has melted in longing (2)!

verses.ar: يَكْفِي يَا نُورَ الْأَهِلَّةِ إِنَّ هَجْرِي طَالْ (2) ۞ سَيِّدِي وَالْعُمْرُ وَلَّى جُدْ بِالْوَصْلِ جُودْ (2)
verses.tr: Yakfī yā nūra l-ahillati inna hajrī ṭāl (2). Sayyidī wa-l-ʿumru wallā jud bi-l-waṣli jūd (2).
verses.en: Enough, O Light of the new moons! My separation has gone on too long (2). My master, life has passed, grant me union with your grace (2)!

verses.ar: يَا نَبِيًّا قَدْ تَحَلَّى حَقًّا بِالْجَمَالْ (2) ۞ وَعَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ صَلَّى رَبِّي ذُو الْجَلَالْ (2)
verses.tr: Yā nabiyyan qad taḥalla ḥaqqan bi-l-jamāl (2). Wa-ʿalayka Llāhu ṣallā Rabbī dhū l-jalāl (2).
verses.en: O Prophet, you have truly been adorned with beauty (2). And upon you, may Allah, the Lord of Majesty, send His endless prayers (2).
